item.title: Rewa thrashes Labasa 3–0 to strengthen semifinal race
item.description: Mohammed Feroz , Karishma Kumari · 07/10/2026 Defending champions, Stratum/Lincoln Rewa has defeated Extra Supermarket Labasa 3–0 in a thrilling FMF Inter-District Championship encounter at HFC Bank Stadium. Both teams started the match at scoring opportunities. Rewa and Labasa controlled the game well in the first half, but neither side could find the back of the net. Rewa stepped up the p
item.content:encoded:
Mohammed Feroz , Karishma Kumari · 07/10/2026

Defending champions, Stratum/Lincoln Rewa has defeated Extra Supermarket Labasa 3–0 in a thrilling FMF Inter-District Championship encounter at HFC Bank Stadium. Both teams started the match at scoring opportunities. Rewa and Labasa controlled the game well in the first half, but neither side could find the back of the net. Rewa stepped up the pressure in the second half, with Josaia Sela finally breaking the deadlock to give Rewa the lead. Merrill Nand then scored two goals to put Rewa 3–0 ahead. The three-goal advantage gave Rewa confidence as they took greater control of the match . Labasa had opportunities to get back into the game, but striker Christopher Wasasala missed two golden chances. Rewa assistant coach Priyant Manu says it was a tough game. He says the players had a clear plan and remained committed to it throughout the match. Manu says Rewa is now just one step away from qualifying for the semifinals. In other matches today, hosts Kells Investment/Global Care Suva were held to a 2-2 draw by Nasinu, Khelvin Realtors Lautoka defeated Pacific Heavy Industries Nadi 5-2 while Vantex Solutions Navua held Dayals Steel Ba 2-2. In tomorrow's matches, Lautoka will face Navua at 1.30pm, Nasinu will take on Labasa at 3.30pm, Nadi will play Ba at 5.30pm, while Rewa will face Suva at 7.30pm.

item.title: Suva held to 2-2 draw by Nasinu
item.description: Suva took the lead in the 38th minute through Gagame Feni and went into the half-time break leading 1-0. Nasinu came out strongly in the second half and found the equaliser before Suva responded to regain the lead at 2-1.
item.content:encoded:
Suva took the lead in the 38th minute through Gagame Feni and went into the half-time break leading 1-0.

Nasinu came out strongly in the second half and found the equaliser before Suva responded to regain the lead at 2-1.

However, Nasinu continued to put pressure on the Suva defence and were rewarded when a Suva defender scored an own goal to level the scores at 2-2.

Neither side was able to find the winner before the final whistle.

Suva coach Pita Rabo says it was a tough match and Nasinu proved to be a strong opponent.

Rabo says their plan was to beat Nasinu by a big margin, but they were unable to achieve that.

He thanked his players for their performance and says tomorrow's match against defending champions Rewa will be crucial for their semi-final hopes.

Rabo says Rewa is a very good team and the match could decide whether Suva progresses to the semi-finals.

In another match, Khelvin Realtors Lautoka secured three crucial points after defeating Pacific Heavy Industries Nadi 5-2.

Meanwhile, Dayals Steel Ba is currently taking on Vantex Solutions Navua.

In the final match of the day, Extra Supermarket Labasa will face defending champions Stratum/Lincoln Rewa at 7.30pm.

item.title: Lautoka secures crucial three points after 5-2 win over Nadi
item.description: Khelvin Realtors Lautoka has secured three crucial points in the FMF Inter-District Championship after defeating Pacific Heavy Industries Nadi 5-2 at the HFC Bank Stadium this afternoon. Lautoka made a strong start, putting Nadi under pressure from the opening whistle.
item.content:encoded:
Khelvin Realtors Lautoka has secured three crucial points in the FMF Inter-District Championship after defeating Pacific Heavy Industries Nadi 5-2 at the HFC Bank Stadium this afternoon.

Lautoka made a strong start, putting Nadi under pressure from the opening whistle.

Epeli Leiroti, Luciano Orzo, Rusiate Matererega and Sterling Vasconcellos scored for Lautoka, while an own goal was scored by Nadi player Vishant Reddy.

Aabid Mohammed and Eneriko Matau scored for Nadi.

The second half was a tough and competitive battle, with both sides creating opportunities.

Lautoka, however, remained in control and scored three more goals to seal the 5-2 victory.

Lautoka coach Banishal Naidu praised his players for following the game plan and delivering a strong performance.

Naidu says the team is taking the tournament one game at a time.

Meanwhile, Kells Investment/Global Care Suva is playing Nasinu.

item.title: Six players suspended from FMF IDC after testing positive for drugs
item.description: Mansi Chand , Mohammed Feroz · 07/10/2026 Six players will be suspended from the FMF Inter-District Championship after testing positive for drugs following tests conducted during the tournament.
item.content:encoded:
Mansi Chand , Mohammed Feroz · 07/10/2026

Six players will be suspended from the FMF Inter-District Championship after testing positive for drugs following tests conducted during the tournament.

Fiji Football Association CEO Mohammed Yusuf says the players who tested positive will not be allowed to continue participating in the tournament.

Yusuf says Fiji FA will not name the players at this stage as they will have to go through the disciplinary process.

He says the players also have the right to defend themselves before the disciplinary committee.

item.title: Messi scores in final Argentina appearance as legendary international career ends
item.description: The 39-year-old converted a second-half penalty to score his 126th international goal in his 208th and final appearance for Argentina. Messi also provided the assists for Nicolas Otamendi and Nico Paz as Argentina completed a comfortable victory at the Monumental Stadium.
item.content:encoded:
The 39-year-old converted a second-half penalty to score his 126th international goal in his 208th and final appearance for Argentina.

Messi also provided the assists for Nicolas Otamendi and Nico Paz as Argentina completed a comfortable victory at the Monumental Stadium.

More than 85,000 fans packed the stadium for Messi's farewell, with the Argentinian captain visibly emotional during the national anthem before kick-off.

A giant Argentina number 10 shirt carrying a thank-you message for Messi was displayed on the field, while the match was also briefly stopped in the 10th minute as supporters gave him a standing ovation.

Messi ends his Argentina career after more than two decades, having won the 2022 FIFA World Cup and the Copa America titles in 2021 and 2024.

He will continue playing at club level with Inter Miami.
